solves.reasoning: (A) achievements=업적(긍정 문맥), (B) inspired=영감(아인슈타인), (C) directed=지휘(프로그램 운영)
(A) graduated=졸업, (B) improved=학습 향상, (C) published=책 출판
(A) earned=학위 취득, (B) discovered=연구 발견, (C) practiced=조언 실천
③ hindered(방해)→원문 improved. wait time 증가가 학습을 향상시킨다는 문맥에 hindered는 부적절
② abandoned(포기)→원문 directed. 과학 교육 프로그램을 지휘한 문맥
④ forgotten(잊힘)→원문 remembered. 선도적 인물로 '기억'된다는 문맥
she ___ a science education program → directed(지휘). published/inspired/graduated는 program과 부적합
Through her research, Rowe ___ that learning could be improved → discovered. served/practiced/graduated 부적합
wait time for students' ___ → responses(응답). achievements/figures/research 문맥 부적합
achievements ≈ accomplishments(성취). defeats=패배, obstacles=장애물, routines=일과 모두 무관
inspired ≈ motivated(동기부여). confused=혼란, alarmed=놀람, restrained=억제 무관
leading ≈ prominent(저명). minor=미미한(반의어), average=평범, temporary=일시적 무관
improved ↔ worsened(악화). enhanced/advanced/strengthened는 모두 유사어
graduated(졸업) ↔ enrolled(입학). completed/finished/concluded는 '마침' 유사어
(A) served as President=직책 맡다, (B) waiter served meals=음식 내다
highest academic degree+advanced study+research = doctorate(박사학위). diploma/certificate/scholarship 불일치
과거시제 문맥: She also ___(serve) as President → served(과거형)
수동태: she was ___(remember) → remembered(과거분사)
she ___ her book, The Process of Knowing → published(출판). discovered/directed/earned는 book과 부적합
increasing teachers' average '___' for students' responses → wait time. 나머지 선지는 연구 주제와 무관
